params.body:
Follows #1101.

## What was still open

#1101 creates the car again when a partner updates a car the dealer deleted, and answers with the new identifier. Whether the partner takes that identifier over from the answer to an update is not in the platform's hands. A partner that keeps the old one got "vehicle already found in system" on every later call: the car was in Stocklist, but nothing the partner sent afterwards reached the dealer, apart from the Car-Pass link.

## What changes

The old id follows the car. When `PUT api/vehicles/{id}/update` names a deleted car of the caller's own dealer and that dealer has a live car with the same chassis number, the call is handled as if it named the live car:

- a partner that is not a premium trader gets the usual refusal, with the proposal (R P3-1.11) and the Car-Pass link (R P3-2.14) on the live car;
- a premium partner updates the live car and gets its detail back.

Without such a live car nothing changes compared to #1101: the call is a create.

Only the chassis number makes two rows the same car: the one the call sends (`main.vin`), else the one on the deleted row. The looser duplicate check of a create (the same eight characteristics) is deliberately not used, so an old id can never land on a different car. Of several live rows with the number, an unsold one goes first, then the newest.

For such a call the validation no longer requires the chassis number to be unique at the dealer. The live car with that number is the car the call is about, and for a premium partner the unique rule refused the call before the controller could decide.

The lookup moved from a private method of the controller to `App\Support\DeletedPartnerCar`, because the request needs the same answer.

## Rules

- New: R P3-2.17 (the old id of a deleted car follows the car).
- R P3-2.16 points to it.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/APartnerUpdateOnADeletedCarCreatesItAgainTest.php`, now 11 tests. New or changed: the old id of a regular partner becomes a proposal on the live car; a partner that keeps the old id reaches the car it created; the old id of a premium partner updates the live car; the old id never lands on a car with another chassis number; a car still for sale goes before a sold one.

- Full suite: 3287 tests, 33245 assertions, green (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, as before).
- PHPStan: no errors.
- Pint on the added files: passed.
params.title: The old id of a deleted car follows the car
